summary.text: Michael Fagg is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 14 (Butler County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2021.
Michael Fagg is listed as chair of the Utilities Committee.

paragraphs.text: Michael Fagg is listed as a member of the Utilities Committee, the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee, the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
The Legislature lists Michael Fagg's occupation as Retired (Banking).
The page names Deborah Fagg as Michael Fagg's spouse.
